parameters.content:
## Tool: search_catalog_books

Input JSON: `{ query?: string, categories?: string[], excludeUserId?: string, limit?: number }`

Busca libros en el catálogo con filtros flexibles (texto libre, categorías, historial del usuario). Devuelve hasta 20 resultados normalizados con `coverUrl`.

parameters.query:
=SELECT
  cb.id,
  cb.title,
  cb.author,
  cb.description,
  cb.cover_url AS "coverUrl",
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT cat.name) FILTER (WHERE cat.name IS NOT NULL) AS categories
FROM catalog_books cb
LEFT JOIN catalog_book_categories cbc ON cbc.catalog_book_id = cb.id
LEFT JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = cbc.category_id
WHERE
  ({{ $json.query === null ? 'TRUE' : `(cb.title ILIKE '%${$json.query.replace(/'/g, "''")}%' OR cb.author ILIKE '%${$json.query.replace(/'/g, "''")}%' OR cb.description ILIKE '%${$json.query.replace(/'/g, "''")}%')` }})
  AND ({{ $json.categories === null ? 'TRUE' : `LOWER(cat.name) = ANY(ARRAY['${$json.categories.map(c => c.replace(/'/g, "''").toLowerCase()).join("','")}'::text])` }})
  AND ({{ $json.excludeUserId === null ? 'TRUE' : `cb.id NOT IN (SELECT oi.catalog_book_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.firebase_uid = '${$json.excludeUserId.replace(/'/g, "''")}')` }})
GROUP BY cb.id, cb.title, cb.author, cb.description, cb.cover_url
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN {{ $json.query === null ? `'a'` : `cb.author ILIKE '%${$json.query.replace(/'/g, "''")}%'` }} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  cb.id
LIMIT {{ $json.limit }};

meta.description: Tool reutilizable: busca libros en catalog_books con filtros de texto, categorías y exclusión de compras del usuario.
